levels.surface: عبد الله بن عبيد الله بن عباس
عبيد الله بن عبد الله بن عباس
عبد الله بن عبيد الله بن عباس

notes: Two remarks name other transmitters for the same saying: Sufyan al-Thawri, and Isma'il b. 'Ulayya with Abd al-Warith b. Sa'id. Both are variant groups, never routes (rule 4).
«وهم فيه الثوري» and «قال وسمعت محمدا يقول» are the compiler's judgement on the variant, not links. «قال أبو عيسى» is the compiler's grading.
Ibn Abbas is the last link; the Prophet is the end of the chain.
